title: Professional, Network Engineering
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
--------------------------

As a **Network Operations Center (NOC) Engineer at Danfoss,** you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the stability, security, and performance of our global IT infrastructure. Your expertise will directly impact seamless connectivity for thousands of employees worldwide, enabling them to innovate and deliver exceptional results. By proactively monitoring and optimizing our network, you will help safeguard business continuity and contribute to building a resilient, future-ready digital ecosystem.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Monitor and Optimize: **Perform 24/7 shift-based monitoring of global network performance** , identifying and resolving issues before they affect operations.
* Respond and Resolve: Act as a key responder for network incidents, conducting diagnostics and troubleshooting to minimize downtime.
* Maintain and Improve: Execute routine maintenance tasks such as firmware updates, configuration changes, and hardware replacements to keep our network robust.
* Secure and Comply: Implement Zero Trust security principles using tools like ClearPass to ensure secure network access.
* Collaborate and Innovate: Work closely with cross-functional IT teams to integrate network solutions seamlessly with other systems.
* Learn and Grow: Stay ahead of emerging networking technologies and trends, continuously enhancing your skills and contributing to innovation.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Technical Expertise: **Strong foundation in routing, switching, VPN, SD-WAN/SASE, and data center networking** . **Deep knowledge of Aruba technologies including Aruba Central, Access Points, Switches, Gateways, ClearPass, and UXI.**
* Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to analyze complex issues, think critically, and deliver effective solutions under pressure.
* Continuous Learner: Passion for staying updated with the latest networking advancements and applying them to improve performance.
* Collaborative Communicator: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively across teams.
* Qualifications: **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, 3+ years of network engineering experience** , Aruba certifications (ACCP, ACSP, ACCX), and familiarity with **ITIL** frameworks.

**What You'll Get from Us**
---------------------------

At Danfoss, we believe in empowering growth and innovation. You will:

* Join a global, forward-thinking organization committed to sustainability and cutting-edge technology.
* Work in a dynamic environment where your ideas matter and your contributions drive real impact.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and advanced training to accelerate your career.
* Be part of a culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and adaptability, helping you unlock your full potential.
* Enjoy a supportive workplace that encourages you to challenge the status quo, learn from experiences, and grow every day.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
-------------------------------

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Senior Administrator - OKTA, CyberArk PAM
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a CIAM Engineer / CIAM Analyst / Specialist – L1/L2 with hands-on operational knowledge of Okta Auth0 and a strong understanding of customer authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), federation and production support. The resource will troubleshoot authentication issues, support application integrations, manage incidents and changes through ServiceNow, participate in migration activities, maintain operational documentation, and provide weekend on-call support as required.

Provide L1/L2 operational support for CIAM services with a primary focus on Okta Auth0. Troubleshoot customer login, authentication, authorization, SSO and federation issues by reviewing relevant logs and configurations. Support SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC)/OAuth 2.0 based application integrations and resolve configuration or connectivity issues. Understand OIDC/OAuth concepts including authorization flows, client applications, redirect URIs, scopes, claims, ID tokens and access tokens. Handle incidents and service requests in ServiceNow with correct prioritization, work notes, SLA tracking, escalation, resolution and closure. Follow the Incident Management process for investigation, stakeholder communication, service restoration and escalation, including support for high-priority incidents. Follow the Change Management process for CIAM configuration and production changes, including implementation, validation, rollback planning, and post-change verification. Support application launch, testing and production readiness activities. Support CIAM migration activities including planning, user/application migration, cutover execution, validation, troubleshooting, rollback readiness, and post-migration stabilization. Participate on the weekend on-call support roster for critical CIAM production incidents, planned changes and migration/cutover activities as required. Perform CIAM health checks, operational monitoring and reporting, and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and troubleshooting documentation. Support certificate management activities for expiration monitoring, renewal/replacement coordination, validation, and post-change verification. Coordinate effectively with L1/L2/L3, application, infrastructure, network, security and vendor teams.

NA

title: Structural Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the structural design of precast systems, including precast columns, beams, hollow-core and double-tee slabs, walls, staircases and cladding panels.
* Design and detail connections (wet and dry joints, corbels, dowels, bearing details, embeds) with attention to constructability, erection sequence and tolerances.
* Carry out analysis and design for gravity, wind and seismic loads, along with handling, transportation and erection stage checks.
* Review and approve precast shop drawings, bar bending schedules and calculations prepared by manufacturers or in-house teams.
* Coordinate with architecture, MEP, geotechnical and construction teams to resolve interfaces, openings and services integration.
* Prepare design basis reports, calculation packages, drawings and technical specifications to applicable Indian Standards and project requirements.
* Respond to RFIs, site queries and non-conformances during fabrication and erection.
* Review, guide and mentor junior engineers and ensure quality, accuracy and timely delivery.
* Support proposals, fee estimates, and client and authority presentations as required.

**Essential:**

* Proven experience in the design of precast concrete structures.
* Strong working knowledge of relevant codes, such as IS 456, IS 875, IS 1893, IS 15916 and allied codes, with familiarity with international standards where relevant (e.g., ACI 318, PCI Design Handbook, Eurocode 2).
* Proficiency in analysis and design software such as ETABS, STAAD.Pro, SAFE, or equivalent.
* Ability to review shop drawings and coordinate with precast manufacturers and site team

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering (mandatory); M.E. / M.Tech in Structural Engineering preferred (Graduate or Post Graduate acceptable).
* **Minimum:** 12 years of relevant structural design experience.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience on data centre projects.
* Experience on multistorey buildings (commercial, residential, industrial or mixed use).
* Familiarity with Tekla Structures, Revit or other BIM tools.
* Exposure to peer review and statutory approvals.

  
**Additional Information**

**Skills and Competencies**

* Technical leadership and sound engineering judgement.
* Clear communication and strong coordination with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
* Mentoring and team development.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. title: Energy Resource Manager (ERM)
description:
**Overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as an Energy Resource Manager (ERM) with the primary focus at reducing stranded capacity applying optimization techniques of space, power, cooling and network. Being a key member of the local Datacenter Operations team in the deployment planning and optimization of the IT capacity, working closely with Electrical Engineers and Critical Environment Field Service Engineer.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I ERM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. By enabling data center capacity through increased Infrastructure Utilization Effectiveness (IUE) and Power Harvesting (PH), you will lead the retrofit efforts to upgrade legacy datacenters and harvest capacity in our existing fleet. As a group, CO+I is focused on personal and professional development for all employees, offer trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 **Responsibilities**

* Primary focus in Managing IT Allocation at the Campus/Metro level by collaborating with key stakeholders and ensuring that demands are properly allocated across the IT infrastructure.
* Familiarize with the Data Center design and manage the IT resources by performing virtual failure analysis and develop a master allocation plan to drive the operationalization of the customer capacity.
* Ensure compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
* Engage with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
* Manage programs associated with the area of responsibility.
* Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
* Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
* Raise risks to the IT capacity allocation and planning. Identify power stranding and contractual inconsistencies (leased spaces).
* Ensure that the critical environment information is properly entered and maintained (tooling).
* Lead programs and projects through leadership forums aligning scope, schedule, and cost that align to our OKRs.

Service Delivery

* Manage the assigned projects or programs to meet service delivery objectives and escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles.
* Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
* Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
* Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.

Data Center Work Environment

* Share best practices; assist others in learning role, process, procedures.
* Collaborate and engage with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across CO+I and engineering groups to gain program / project insights.
* Leverage and synthesize these insights to develop and operationalize solutions that mitigate our customer gaps.
* Provide mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.
* Seek training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives.
* Suggest ways of reducing risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
* Suggest improvements in implementation based on depth of understanding.
* Contribute to a positive team environment by learning and adopting best practices.
* Contribute constructively during team meetings and in cross-discipline collaborations within the service team.
* Recognize priority of team success over individual achievement.
* Collaborate and negotiate effectively with others and seek guidance from management to identify delegates to deliver results.

Ownership

* In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Other · Embody our Microsoft One culture and values.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelores in Electrical Engineering or equivalent AND 3+ years’ experience supporting critical service infrastructure operation, maintenance, projects in large-scale OR equivalent experience.
* Fluency in English language skills.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* 5+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructure (e.g., UPS, PDUs, Generators, AHU/CFM, ability to read and interpret electrical one-line diagrams and working with IT infrastructure modifications (e.g., Cable trays, Fiber Runners, HACs and IT equipment).

title: Manager-Tech Ops Engineering
description:
At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence, advancing digital commerce, or enabling people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible.

When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global community committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We provide opportunities to learn, grow, innovate, and build meaningful careers while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and integrity.

Together, we’ll lead the way in delivering innovative, secure, and reliable technology solutions that power millions of customer interactions every day.

Join #TeamAmex and let's lead the way together.
  
  
**About Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support**

Enterprise Identity is the foundation of American Express's digital customer experience, enabling secure, seamless, and reliable authentication and authorization across our digital ecosystem.

The Enterprise Identity Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Application Support organization plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational resilience of mission-critical Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms.

Our technology ecosystem includes customer authentication and logon services, OAuth-based authorization capabilities supporting Open Banking, customer identity systems of record such as Product Registry and Profile, and advanced authentication and verification capabilities including One Auth, AuthN+, and Verification Services.

Operating in a highly distributed, always-on environment, our teams support platforms with availability objectives of 99.99% and above. Through a global follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States and India, we deliver 24x7x365 operational coverage.

We partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Delivery teams to engineer reliability into our platforms, accelerate automation, improve observability, and continuously enhance production stability.

**How Will You Make an Impact in This Role?**

* We are seeking a technically accomplished and results-driven Manager Tech Ops Engineering – Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support to lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of critical customer identity platforms.
* This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring strong expertise in site reliability engineering, modern application architectures, cloud-native technologies, production troubleshooting, observability, and automation.
* The successful candidate will combine deep engineering knowledge with strong people leadership to drive operational transformation, reduce production incidents, improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore/Recover (MTTR), and establish scalable, proactive, and automated reliability practices.
* You will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex production challenges, working across engineering and business teams to improve system resilience, eliminate recurring issues, and enable reliable delivery of new capabilities.
* Beyond managing day-to-day operations, you will help evolve traditional application support into an engineering-driven SRE organization focused on automation, proactive detection, self-healing, and continuous reliability improvement.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education & Professional Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering, or application support for large-scale enterprise applications.
* 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience supporting business-critical, highly available applications in a 24x7 production environment.
Strong experience troubleshooting complex distributed applications and leading technical incident resolution.  

**Technical Engineering Expertise**

* Strong programming and scripting skills in at least one language such as Python, Java, or Ruby, with the ability to develop automation, diagnostic utilities, and operational tools.
* Hands-on experience supporting Java-based enterprise applications, including Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, application dependencies, HTTP/HTTPS, network fundamentals, load balancing, caching, and database connectivity.
* Experience with containerized applications and cloud-native platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong knowledge of application troubleshooting, performance analysis, system diagnostics, and production debugging.
Experience implementing or supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management processes.  

**Reliability, Observability & Automation**

* 5+ years of experience implementing or operating application monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability solutions.
* Hands-on experience with one or more observability platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or equivalent tools.
* 3+ years of experience developing operational automation, scripting solutions, or automated remediation workflows.
* Demonstrated understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and toil reduction.
* Experience improving application availability, resilience, performance, and operational efficiency through engineering-driven solutions.
Strong experience in root cause analysis, production problem management, and implementation of preventive measures.  

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through high-priority production incidents and complex technical investigations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to translate technical challenges and operational risks into clear recommendations and actionable improvement plans.
Experience collaborating across geographically distributed engineering and support teams.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Identity & Security Engineering**

* Experience supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), authentication, or authorization platforms.
* Understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), Single Sign-On (SSO), and related identity protocols.
* Familiarity with API security, token lifecycle management, session management, and authentication workflows.
Experience supporting customer-facing identity services in financial services or other highly regulated environments.  

**Advanced SRE & Platform Engineering**

* Prior experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, Software Engineer, or technical lead supporting large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience designing or improving highly available, fault-tolerant, and horizontally scalable application architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift troubleshooting, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational practices.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and automation frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with resilience engineering techniques, including load testing, failover testing, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery validation.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, application performance management, and service dependency mapping.  

**AIOps & Intelligent Operations**

* Experience implementing AIOps capabilities, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring, or intelligent incident management.
* Exposure to AI-assisted operational tooling, automated diagnostics, and self-healing architectures.
Experience developing automation frameworks or internal tools that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational toil.  

**Operational Excellence**

* Working knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, including incident, problem, change, and release management.
* Experience with production readiness assessments, operational risk management, and non-functional requirements validation.
* Experience establishing reliability dashboards, operational scorecards, and measurable continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and drive cross-functional technical initiatives.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

description:

You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy pro-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
* Architect and implement end-to-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0.3.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout-resilient pipelines across SAP and non-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale

* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
* SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

title: Sr. Director, Security Engineering
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

The Senior Director, Product Security & PSIRT, will lead large-enterprise product security programs across Gigamon’s hardware and software portfolio. This role will set the strategic direction for the PSIRT team, chair the PSIRT Steering Committee, and partner with VP and executive leadership to drive timely, risk-based decisions. Serving as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, the leader will establish consistent, repeatable practices for vulnerability research, testing, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base content, and coordinated disclosure. They will also develop Gigamon’s product red-team framework, evaluate appropriate security tools, and advise the CISO on the evolving product security tool landscape.

**What you’ll do**

* Set the strategic direction, priorities, and operating model for Gigamon’s Product Security and PSIRT programs.
* Lead and develop the PSIRT team, including mentoring junior PSIRT engineers and establishing clear expectations for performance, technical growth, and delivery.
* Chair the PSIRT Steering Committee and partner with VP and executive leadership to assess material vulnerabilities, prioritize response activities, and drive accountability.
* Serve as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, providing clear assessments of product security risks, response options, remediation progress, and business impact.
* Establish consistent, repeatable processes for vulnerability intake, research, testing, triage, remediation tracking, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base articles, and coordinated disclosure.
* Lead vulnerability research and testing across Gigamon’s hardware and software products, including attack-surface analysis, product behavior analysis, exploitability assessment, and validation of remediation.
* Develop a product red-team framework covering engagement models, testing methodologies, objectives, reporting standards, risk prioritization, and remediation follow-through.
* Coordinate product red-team and adversarial testing activities with internal teams and qualified external providers, as appropriate.
* Evaluate the product security and red-team tool landscape and advise the CISO on tool selection, adoption, integration, and investment priorities.
* Translate vulnerability research and adversarial testing results into practical security improvements and risk-based remediation plans.
* Guide product and engineering teams in applying secure development practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic application security testing, fuzzing, penetration testing, and secure release processes.
* Oversee security advisories, customer notifications, frequently asked questions, remediation guidance, and other communications related to product vulnerabilities.
* Establish release security governance, including security reviews, risk acceptance, exception management, and criteria for product security readiness.
* Partner with product, engineering, threat research, detection, support, customer success, legal, and communications teams to coordinate vulnerability response and improve product security outcomes.
* Identify appropriate opportunities to use automation and artificial intelligence in vulnerability research, testing, PSIRT operations, and security communications while maintaining oversight, quality, and accountability.
* Communicate product security posture, material risks, response status, and remediation progress clearly to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

**What you’ve done**

* Bring at least 10 years of progressive PSIRT experience, including leadership of large-enterprise product security programs.
* Led or scaled PSIRT, product security, vulnerability research, security engineering, or closely related programs across hardware, software, networking, or security products.
* Established strategic direction, operating models, priorities, and measurable delivery expectations for product security teams.
* Developed and mentored junior PSIRT engineers while building technical capability and supporting career growth.
* Led vulnerability intake, triage, research, testing, remediation tracking, customer engagement, security advisories, and coordinated disclosure.
* Developed or operated red-team, adversarial testing, penetration testing, or vulnerability research programs.
* Created frameworks, methodologies, or operating models for product red-team activities where a formal capability was not previously established.
* Evaluated security testing and product security tools and advised senior security leaders on technology selection, adoption, and investment.
* Chaired or operated an executive-level security steering committee and partnered effectively with COO, CISO, VP, and executive leadership on risk decisions.
* Served as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives on product security posture, material vulnerabilities, remediation strategies, and business risk.
* Applied secure development practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic application security testing, fuzzing, penetration testing, and secure release governance.
* Translated complex vulnerabilities and adversarial findings into practical engineering actions, risk-based priorities, and clear executive decisions.
* Set priorities and delivered measurable results through organizational change and competing business demands.
* Worked effectively across distributed product and engineering organizations without relying solely on direct authority.
* Applied knowledge of Linux, operating-system security, embedded systems, networking, cloud platforms, or platform engineering.
* Applied automation or artificial intelligence to software security, vulnerability research, red teaming, PSIRT operations, or engineering workflows.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, cybersecurity, or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent professional experience.

**Who you are**

* A strategic and technically credible product security leader who can set direction while engaging deeply with complex hardware and software security challenges.
* An experienced PSIRT operator who establishes durable processes and delivers consistent, high-quality outcomes.
* A builder who can develop practical red-team frameworks and mature emerging product security capabilities.
* A pragmatic technology strategist who evaluates tools based on effectiveness, scalability, integration, operational fit, and cost.
* A trusted technical advisor who provides clear, balanced guidance to the COO, CISO, and executive leadership.
* A decisive executive partner who can chair a steering committee, establish accountability, and drive timely action.
* A practical problem solver who helps product and engineering teams balance security, delivery, reliability, customer impact, and business requirements.
* A clear communicator who explains technical vulnerabilities, remediation priorities, response decisions, and business implications without alarmism.
* A customer-focused leader who values accurate, consistent, and actionable security communications.
* A collaborative partner who builds trust across product, engineering, threat research, detection, support, customer success, legal, communications, and executive teams.
* A people-focused leader who develops junior engineers, grows technical capability, and creates a high-performing, inclusive organization.
* An accountable operator who sets priorities, follows through on commitments, and makes sound risk-based decisions.
* A global-minded leader who works effectively across distributed teams and makes product security a shared responsibility.

description:

* Own complex networking features end to end, from requirements and architecture through validation and delivery of production-quality Dell Enterprise SONiC software.

title: Architect I - Software Testing- Facets + Playwright Automation
description:
**Role description**

We are seeking a highly experienced **Automation Architect** to define and drive the organization’s enterprise test automation strategy, with **Playwright** as the primary framework for modern web automation.

The ideal candidate will architect, govern, and implement scalable automation solutions across **web applications, APIs, databases, batch processes, and end-to-end business workflows**, including applications within the **TriZetto Facets healthcare payer ecosystem**.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for defining automation roadmaps, establishing enterprise frameworks and engineering standards, identifying high-value automation opportunities, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and building sustainable automation capabilities that improve software quality, accelerate releases, and reduce manual testing effort.

Key Responsibilities

### **Automation Strategy & Architecture**

* Define and execute the enterprise **test automation vision, roadmap, and target-state architecture**.
* Establish **Playwright** as a strategic automation framework for modern web applications.
* Design scalable and reusable automation architecture covering **web, API, database, batch, and end-to-end testing**.
* Establish automation governance, coding standards, design principles, framework guidelines, and engineering best practices across delivery teams.
* Conduct automation assessments and identify high-value candidates based on business criticality, execution frequency, complexity, maintainability, and ROI.
* Define a unified automation approach for business processes spanning multiple applications and integration layers.
* Establish strategies for **test-data management, environment management, execution orchestration, reporting, and defect diagnostics**.

### **Playwright Automation**

* Architect and develop enterprise-grade **Playwright frameworks using TypeScript or JavaScript**.
* Implement framework patterns including **Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable components, utilities, configuration management, and data-driven testing**.
* Design automation supporting **cross-browser, parallel, UI, and API testing**.
* Automate member, provider, customer service, and other enterprise portals within the healthcare payer ecosystem.
* Implement robust handling of **dynamic elements, synchronization, waits, authentication, test data, retry mechanisms, and flaky tests**.
* Leverage Playwright capabilities such as **traces, screenshots, videos, reporting, network interception, API testing, and parallel execution** for efficient execution and defect analysis.
* Mentor automation engineers and QA teams on Playwright architecture, framework development, coding standards, and troubleshooting practices.

### **API & Integration Automation**

* Define enterprise-level **API automation strategy and architecture**.
* Build reusable automation for REST-based services and application integrations.
* Design automated validation across **UI, API, database, EDI, and batch processing layers**.
* Establish strategies for service-level validation, test-data setup, response validation, negative testing, and integration testing.
* Design end-to-end automated workflows that validate business transactions across multiple systems.
* Integrate API automation with Playwright and other enterprise automation frameworks where appropriate.

### **CI/CD & Quality Engineering**

* Integrate automated test suites with **Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and/or GitHub Actions**.
* Define automation execution strategies across pull requests, continuous integration, regression, release, and scheduled pipelines.
* Enable parallel and distributed execution to improve feedback time.
* Establish automated reporting and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines.
* Track framework and execution metrics including **pass rates, flaky-test rates, execution duration, automation coverage, defect detection, and pipeline stability**.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement **shift-left and continuous testing practices**.

### **Solution Design & Delivery**

* Architect end-to-end automation solutions covering **web, API, database, EDI, and batch validation**.
* Evaluate automation technologies and recommend appropriate tools based on application architecture, scalability, maintainability, integration capability, and total cost of ownership.
* Ensure automation platforms meet enterprise requirements for **security, scalability, maintainability, reliability, compliance, and operational sustainability**.
* Define secure test-data management practices appropriate for **HIPAA-regulated healthcare environments**.
* Provide technical leadership throughout framework design, implementation, deployment, migration, and ongoing modernization.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical reviews of automation solutions developed across delivery teams.

### **Automation CoE & Governance**

* Establish and lead an **Automation Center of Excellence (CoE)**.
* Define enterprise automation standards, reusable assets, reference architectures, framework templates, and governance processes.
* Establish technical review and framework onboarding processes for project teams.
* Develop reusable automation accelerators to improve delivery efficiency across programs.
* Define appropriate KPIs for evaluating automation maturity and effectiveness.
* Drive framework adoption and standardization across multiple products and delivery teams.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with QA leadership, product teams, business stakeholders, developers, enterprise architects, DevOps, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and delivery teams.
* Present **automation strategies, architecture proposals, investment requirements, business cases, ROI, and roadmaps** to senior leadership.
* Translate business priorities into practical automation strategies.
* Manage technical engagements with automation vendors and strategic partners.
* Influence engineering teams to adopt common quality-engineering and automation practices.

### **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of **Generative AI** for areas such as test-case design, automation script generation, code optimization, test-data generation, failure analysis, and self-healing automation.
* Evaluate emerging automation technologies, AI-assisted testing capabilities, and quality-engineering practices.
* Continuously improve framework performance, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Monitor automation coverage, stability, execution trends, productivity improvements, ROI, and benefits realization.

  
**Skills**

API Testing, Playwright, FACETS, Test Automation, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Generative AI, JavaScript, Robotic Process Automation, SQL

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Network Engineer 2
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

This job is responsible for managing the application of network security protocols and updating disaster recovery plans. It involves directing engineers in security best practices and maintaining the network's defense systems. The role plays a crucial part in protecting the Company's information systems.

**Job Description**

**Job summary**  
Independently performs standard network upgrades using approved automation tools and completes documented manual upgrades when tools fail, while troubleshooting common network and upgrade-related issues.

**Key roles and responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day operational support for routers and switches, including alert response, incident handling, service requests, and standard changes.
* Troubleshoot common interface, reachability, packet-loss, latency, hardware, and configuration issues.
* Own assigned tickets through diagnosis, remediation, validation, documentation, and closure within established priorities and escalation paths.
* Perform device health checks, configuration backup and restore, software and hardware inventory updates, and operational readiness checks.
* Review MOPs, prerequisites, image compatibility, device readiness, backups, and rollback requirements before execution.
* Execute standard upgrades through approved tools and validate each workflow stage and result.
* Perform manual network device upgrades using the approved MOP when the automation tool is unavailable, fails, or produces incomplete results.
* Troubleshoot common image transfer, boot variable, storage, reachability, protocol adjacency, interface, authentication, and post-upgrade validation issues.
* Make controlled decisions within the MOP, stop work when risk thresholds are reached, and escalate complex or service-impacting conditions.
* Execute rollback procedures and verify service restoration when upgrade acceptance criteria are not met.
* Coordinate with operations, engineering, application, monitoring, and change-management teams during maintenance activities.
* Document defects and improvement opportunities in upgrade tools and procedures.

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Working knowledge of IPv4/IPv6, TCP/IP, MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and IS-IS.
* Hands-on experience with routers and switches from Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or Nokia.
* Experience with network OS upgrades, configuration backup/restore, monitoring, logs, and incident troubleshooting.
* Basic scripting or automation awareness is desirable.

**Education and certifications**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Sc/MCA or equivalent technology qualification.
* Preferred certification: CCNA/CCNP, JNCIA/JNCIS

**Common behavioral attributes**

* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Disciplined adherence to approved procedures and change controls.
* Collaborative, transparent, and accountable working style.
* Continuous learning and support for innovative technology.
* Ability to remain methodical during maintenance windows and service-impacting events.

We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

2-5 Years

title: Senior Network Engineer (Voice & IPX)
description:
**Employment Type**
-------------------

Permanent

**Closing Date**
----------------

12 Nov 2026 11:59pm

**Job Title**
-------------

Senior Network Engineer (Voice & IPX)

**Job Summary**

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

As a **Senior Network Engineer (Voice & IPX)** , you’ll help shape the future of Telstra’s international mobility, voice, and interconnect capabilities.

  

This individual contributor role is responsible for ensuring Telstra’s international network delivers a reliable, high-quality experience for interconnect and roaming partners, suppliers, and customers. You’ll contribute to the analysis, architecture, design, development, deployment, and optimisation of network technologies, with a strong focus on interoperability across multiple network domains.

  

You’ll drive technology evolution across Telstra’s International Core Voice, IPX, and Mobility/Roaming platforms, delivering scalable and resilient solutions supporting international voice, mobility and roaming services, signalling platforms, and specialised international network services.

  

Your focus will span the infrastructure, virtualisation, orchestration, application, IP network, and security layers, including:

  

* Oracle DSR, Ribbon SBC and PSX, and A2P SMS applications
* Cisco and Juniper switching and routing
* Check Point firewalls and network security
NFV, cloud-native architectures, orchestration, and automation  

  

You’ll provide technical leadership in delivering innovative, next-generation network solutions that improve service quality, operational efficiency, resilience, and Telstra’s position in the global mobility and interconnect landscape.

  

**What We Offer**

* Performance-related pay
* Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
* Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.
* Purchased annual leave scheme
* Additional Telstra day off
* Additional 30% off Telstra products and services
Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)  

  

**What You’ll do**

* Design, develop, deploy, and optimise solutions across International Voice, IPX, Mobility, and Roaming networks.
* Drive network transformation through NFV, cloud adoption, automation, and software-defined networking.
* Deliver secure, scalable, high-performing interconnect and roaming solutions.
* Provide specialist expertise across signalling, voice, IPX, roaming, and interconnect, ensuring integration with adjacent network technologies.
* Support Cisco and Juniper switching and routing infrastructure across the International Voice and IPX networks.
* Manage Check Point firewalls and network security controls, ensuring compliance with Telstra security policies and standards.
* Manage deployment, configuration, and lifecycle of Oracle DSR, Ribbon SBC and PSX, and A2P SMS platforms.
* Manage and support the infrastructure, virtualisation, and orchestration layers hosting International platforms and applications.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, international partners, customers, and vendors to deliver strategic network capabilities.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex network issues to maintain service availability and customer experience.
* Manage hardware and software currency, security patching, resiliency assessments, and sustainability requirements.
* Produce and review High Level Designs, test plans, and Methods of Procedure, and execute changes under Telstra change governance.
Contribute to network strategy, technology roadmaps, architecture standards, and continuous improvement.  

  

**Your Technical Expertise**

  

You’ll bring strong knowledge and experience across:

* **Voice & IPX:** Softswitches, Ribbon SBC, Ribbon PSX, Media Gateways, Oracle DSR, Oracle/Tekelec EAGLE STP, DNS/ENUM, A2P SMS
* **Protocols:** VoIP, SIP, TDM, IPX, Diameter, SS7/SIGTRAN, LTE, 3G/4G/5G, VoLTE/IMS
* **IP & Security:** Cisco and Juniper switching/routing, IP/MPLS, VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, Check Point firewalls, network segmentation, signalling and interconnect security
* **Virtualisation & Orchestration:** Red Hat Virtualisation, NFV/VNF/CNF, cloud-native platforms, orchestration and automation tooling
* **Network Domains:** International Core Voice & IPX, Voice & IPX Signalling, Mobility & Roaming, Wholesale Voice, OTT Voice
* **Monitoring & Assurance:** Traffic Management Systems, Real-Time Traffic Monitoring, Genview Analytics, Performance Intelligence Centre, Splunk, Grafana, Inventory Management
* **Lifecycle Management:** Hardware and Software Currency, Security Patching, Resiliency and Sustainability Concepts and Management

  

**About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant technical qualifications.
* Minimum 8 years’ relevant experience in voice, signalling, IPX, and/or mobility/roaming network engineering.
* Strong understanding of international Voice, IPX, Mobility/Roaming, and carrier interconnect requirements.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle DSR, Ribbon SBC and PSX, and A2P SMS platforms, including deployment and management.
* Experience configuring and supporting Cisco and Juniper switches and routers in carrier-grade environments.
* Experience managing Check Point firewalls and network security controls.
* Sound knowledge of virtualisation, NFV, cloud-native architectures, and orchestration platforms.
* Sound understanding of SIP, Diameter, SS7/SIGTRAN, and IP networking protocols.
* Experience as a technical lead on medium to large engineering projects, preferably across voice or mobility networks.
* Ability to review technical solutions, conduct impact analysis, and plan controlled implementations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, vendor, and stakeholder management skills.
Certifications such as CCNP, JNCIP, Check Point CCSA/CCSE, or Red Hat will be highly regarded.  

  

**Who You’ll Work With**

  

Internally, you’ll work closely with:

* IP, Transmission, Security, and Network Optimisation teams
* Voice Network Operations groups (TGOC) and Major Incident Management
* Product, Architecture, and Cloud/Virtualisation Infrastructure teams
* Network Resilience, Change Management, and Cyber Security teams
Finance teams  

  

Externally, you’ll coordinate and deliver programs under the International Voice and IPX Engineering program of works, partnering with international interconnect and roaming partners, IPX carriers, customers, and technology vendors including Oracle, Ribbon, Cisco, Juniper, and Check Point.

  

**Why Join This Team?**

You’ll work at the heart of Telstra’s international network, combining carrier-grade telecommunications expertise with NFV, cloud-native networking, automation, orchestration, and next-generation network technologies.

It’s an opportunity to influence the evolution of Telstra’s international Voice, IPX, signalling, mobility, roaming, IP, security, and virtualisation environments while working with global partners and leading technology vendors.

**Diversity is more than a policy – it’s how we thrive**

We know diverse teams deliver better outcomes, and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported — regardless of gender, background, or ability.

We strongly encourage women and gender-diverse people to apply and are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements or adjustments to the recruitment process.

title: IBMS Engineer
description:
The Data Center IBMS Engineer is responsible for the operation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and integration of the Integrated Building Management System (IBMS) within a mission-critical data center environment. The role involves monitoring critical building infrastructure, ensuring system availability, coordinating with MEP teams, and maintaining reliable communication between various building automation systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and operate the IBMS/BMS system for data center facilities.
* Monitor critical infrastructure systems, including:
* HVAC systems (AHU, FCU, Chillers, CRAH, CRAC).
* Electrical systems (UPS, DG, LT Panels, HT Panels, PDU).
* Fire Alarm System (FAS).
* Fire Fighting System.
* Access Control System (ACS).
* CCTV and security systems.
* Water Leak Detection System.
* Environmental monitoring systems.
* Troubleshoot IBMS alarms, communication failures, and system faults.
* Monitor real-time parameters, alarms, trends, and equipment status through IBMS workstations.
* Perform preventive maintenance and support corrective maintenance activities.
* Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and fire safety teams.
* Monitor communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP.
* Support integration of third-party systems with IBMS.
* Verify field devices, sensors, actuators, controllers, and communication networks.
* Maintain alarm logs, daily reports, incident reports, and maintenance records.
* Support system testing, commissioning, and integrated system testing (IST).
* Follow data center SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, and emergency response procedures.
* Ensure compliance with safety procedures and data center operational standards.

Technical Skills Required

* Knowledge of IBMS/BMS architecture and operation.
* Knowledge of PLC, DDC, and automation controllers.
* Understanding of BACnet, Modbus RTU/TCP, and SNMP protocols.
* Knowledge of HVAC and electrical systems.
* Experience with SCADA/BMS monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of sensors, actuators, control panels, and field instrumentation.
* Basic networking knowledge (IP addressing, switches, communication troubleshooting).
* Knowledge of alarm management and system integration.

Educational Qualification

- Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics

Preferred Experience

* Experience in data center operations or critical facilities.
* Experience with IBMS/BMS monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Exposure to data center commissioning and integrated system testing.
* Knowledge of Tier III / Tier IV data center operations is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* IBMS system availability and reliability.
* Timely response to critical alarms.
* Reduction in recurring system faults.
* Completion of preventive maintenance activities.
* Accuracy of daily operational reports.
* Compliance with SOP, MOP, and EOP procedures.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember. In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence. What you will do Analyze and Solve •Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes •Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities •Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability •Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions Design and Integrate •Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies •Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation •Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors •Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity Collaborate and Deliver •Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians •Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines •Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders •Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results Grow and Advance •Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies •Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects •Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**  
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Manufacturing Design Opportunities
description:
Summary
  
  
How do you build a great idea? With more great ideas — the kind of thinking that transforms the work of our industrial designers into the devices that enrich the lives of our customers. Join this team to develop manufacturing engineering solutions that deliver our products with outstanding precision at an unprecedented scale. You’ll help design and customize equipment, build manufacturing processes, refine tooling, identify suppliers, and work with key operations partners to optimize capacity and cost — without losing sight of our incredibly high standards for quality!
  
  
Description
  
  
Global Supply Manager Apple GSMs own the commercial relationship with our enclosure manufacturing partners and are responsible for cost negotiations, continuity of supply, risk management, driving operational and cost efficiencies through process or design change, as well overall project execution. GSMs sit at the intersection of Apple's business activities and engineering communities, and effectively balance the needs of both groups to ensure successful product launches. Enclosure components (such as the housing) define the look, feel and expression of Apple’s globally recognized industrial and product design. GSMs work in concert with operations, manufacturing quality, and manufacturing design engineers as well as Apple’s Product Design and Industrial Design teams. Together, these teams execute and scale both new and existing manufacturing processes, materials, technologies, finishes and form factors. Manufacturing Design Engineer The Apple Manufacturing Design Engineer (MDE) is accountable for leading the development and implementation of high precision mechanical manufacturing processes across Apple’s worldwide supply base. In this highly visible hands-on role, you will have direct frequent communication and collaboration with Apple Industrial Design, Product Design, and Manufacturing Design partners, as well as our worldwide suppliers. The MDE role is empowered and expected to bring creativity to Apple’s manufacturing approach, enabling us to deliver our best work to as many customers as possible. You will be a part of collaborative environment contributing to the creation, evaluation, and implementation of end-to-end manufacturing solutions for Apple's hardware enclosures. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders in Quality Engineering, Global Supply Management, Product Design, and Industrial Design in order to ensure our manufacturing solutions meet our product quality, cost, yield, capacity, schedule, and environmental goals. Manufacturing Design Program Manager The Manufacturing Design Program Manager (MDPM) is responsible for managing and guiding development activities of highly skilled process development, operations, and quality teams within Apple’s Manufacturing Design group. The MDPM will lead the team to develop processes for building extraordinary products from existing and new ideas based on business needs. The MDPM should possess a blend of business and technical knowledge, allowing for big-picture vision and the ability to dive deep into specific challenges. MDPM team members operate autonomously, demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, and juggle competing priorities with ease. Manufacturing Quality Engineer Manufacturing Quality Engineers work in tandem with Apple's world-class designers to develop measurement technologies, control strategies, information systems, and manufacturing methods that achieve visionary specifications at massive production scale. We lead a network of supplier factories worldwide, with responsibility for our partners' delivery to aggressive schedules. Our focus is on elegant execution of extraordinary designs, resulting in products that thrill our customers. New Product Operations Program Manager We are the primary operations interface to the core product development team and Module Engineering team within Apple. As the owner of the program, through direct involvement and/or influence, you will ensure the successful launch of the product towards meeting it’s stated Cost, Quality, Schedule, Availability and Customer Experience goals. New Product Operations is pivotal to the dynamic development and launch of Apple’s products. We are a team of driven, organized and detail-oriented individuals who excel in program management. Software Engineer The Manufacturing Design team enables the mass production of Apple's entire product line from iPhones, iPads, and MacBooks to the Mac Pro, AppleTV, Apple Watch and Vision Pro. Part of the magic that makes all of this possible is a robust set of applications and systems designed and developed by Apple that support production from prototype to announcement and beyond. The applications we build are used daily by the people at Apple that design our products along with those that figure out how to make them at scale. This includes; Manufacturing Design Engineers, Product Designers, Mechanical Engineers, Quality Engineers, Supply Chain Managers, along with our Suppliers. We work closely with them to design and architect the best solutions for the challenges faced when making the highest quality hardware products. Subject Matter Expert The Apple Subject Matter Expert (SME) is accountable for driving the development of manufacturing processes across Apple’s worldwide supply base. As the expert technical member of the Manufacturing Design Team, you will have direct frequent communication and collaboration with Apple Industrial Design, Product Design, Manufacturing Design partners and worldwide suppliers. You will investigate and develop solutions to overcome ambitious technical tasks that require non-standard manufacturing approaches. Tooling Engineer Apple’s Tooling Engineers lead the development of new plastic injection tooling projects and metal tooling processes in effort to meet a wide range of product performance and cosmetic requirements. We act as the interface between our product design groups and our suppliers, and drive development of extraordinary plastic molding and metal forming tooling and processes at our supply base.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Qualifications will vary by role
* Experience in manufacturing, engineering, quality, process development, program management or supply chain management
* Ability to use data to solve problems and make products
* Proven track record of delivering on challenging projects with tight deadlines while managing multiple priorities and stakeholders
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas to peers, stakeholders and leaders
* BS IE, ME or applicable degree

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Qualifications will vary by role

title: Calibration Engineer Onsite

We are hiring design engineers in four disciplines. They will own the calculations, schematics and drawings for their discipline, which are reviewed for code compliance before anything reaches site.

title: AI Ops Engineer
description:
The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team.  
In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production.

* **Cloud Platform Engineering:** Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads.
* **AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines:** Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
* **Containerization & Orchestration:** Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads.
* **Observability & Reliability:** Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production.
* **Security & Governance:** Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
* **Developer Enablement:** Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production.  
    
  **Skills Knowledge Required**
  + **Cloud Platform:** Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager.
  + **DevOps / SRE Practices:** Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging.
  + **AI-Ops / LLMOps:** Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs.
  + **Scripting & Automation:** Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators.
  + **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably.
  + **Security & Compliance:** Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments.
  + **Analytics Workflow Understanding:** Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them.
* **Qualifications Experience**
  + **Education:** Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  + **DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience:** 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production.
  + **AI/MLOps Engineering:** Proven track record of implementing CI/CD for AI workloads, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure management (Terraform, Cloud Build, GKE).
  + **Automation & Reliability:** Demonstrated experience with infrastructure automation, incident response, and building observable, self-healing production systems.
  + **Good to Have (Optional)::** Previous exposure to the Banking, Financial Services, or Credit Analytics industries. Experience with Machine Learning engineering and model serving frameworks, or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect).
