title: Labour & Vendor Management
description:
Job Title: Manager – Vendor & Labour Management

**Experience:** 10+ Years  
**Department:** Procurement / Project Operations  
**Industry:** Construction / Architecture / Real Estate  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced professional to manage vendor relationships, subcontractor coordination and labour operations across construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the timely availability of materials, skilled manpower and services while maintaining cost efficiency and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

**Vendor Management**

* Identify, evaluate and onboard reliable vendors, suppliers and contractors.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing vendors.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms and delivery schedules.
* Obtain and compare quotations to ensure cost-effective procurement.
* Monitor vendor performance, material quality and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with the procurement and finance teams for purchase orders and vendor payments.
* Resolve vendor-related issues and ensure uninterrupted project operations.

**Labour Management**

* Plan and arrange skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled labour based on project requirements.
* Coordinate with labour contractors and subcontractors.
* Monitor labour attendance, productivity and deployment across project sites.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability to meet project schedules.
* Manage labour allocation, work schedules and site requirements.
* Address labour-related grievances and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, safety standards and statutory requirements.

**Reporting & Coordination**

* Maintain vendor databases, labour records and contractor details.
* Track procurement costs and labour expenses.
* Prepare regular reports on vendor performance and manpower availability.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and Site Engineers to understand upcoming requirements.
* Implement effective vendor and labour management processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Business Administration or a relevant field.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in vendor management, labour management or construction operations.
* Strong network of construction material suppliers, contractors and labour agencies.
* Excellent negotiation, coordination and communication skills.
* Knowledge of construction procurement and labour management.
* Strong problem-solving and team management abilities.
* Knowledge of labour compliance and statutory requirements is preferred.

Preferred Candidate

A highly experienced professional with strong industry connections, excellent negotiation skills and the ability to manage vendors, contractors and large labour teams efficiently.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Job Description – Electrical Engineer (Roles & Responsibilities)

Designation: Electrical EngineerDepartment: Electrical MaintenanceQualification: Diploma / BE – Electrical & Electronics EngineeringExperience: 3–5 YearsIndustry: Sheet Metal Stamping / Automotive ComponentsReporting To: Electrical Maintenance Manager / Plant Head

1. Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)A. Electrical Maintenance

* Carry out preventive and breakdown maintenance of all electrical equipment and machinery.
* Ensure uninterrupted power supply to production machines and utilities.
* Attend electrical breakdowns and complete troubleshooting within minimum time.
* Maintain electrical panels, motors, transformers, compressors and other electrical equipment.
* Monitor machine electrical performance and identify potential failures.
* Maintain electrical maintenance history and breakdown records.

B. Machine & Equipment Maintenance

* Handle electrical maintenance of hydraulic presses, mechanical presses and other production machines.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, sensors, relays, contactors and control circuits.
* Maintain servo motors, VFDs, control panels and electrical drives.
* Support machine installation, commissioning and electrical modifications.
* Coordinate with machine suppliers for technical support and breakdown rectification.
* Ensure proper functioning of safety interlocks, emergency stops and machine protection systems.

C. PLC & Automation

* Basic to good knowledge of PLC programming and troubleshooting.
* Identify and rectify PLC input/output and communication-related issues.
* Understand electrical control circuit drawings and ladder logic.
* Handle VFD parameter settings and servo drive troubleshooting.
* Support automation projects and machine improvement activities.
* Coordinate with automation vendors for programming and commissioning.

D. Utility & Power Management

* Monitor electrical power consumption and identify energy-saving opportunities.
* Maintain DG sets, compressors, cooling systems and other electrical utilities.
* Monitor transformer, LT panels and distribution systems.
* Ensure proper functioning of electrical distribution networks.
* Monitor power factor and take corrective action to maintain the required level.
* Maintain electrical load records and energy consumption reports.

E. Safety & Statutory Compliance

* Ensure electrical safety procedures are followed throughout the factory.
* Conduct regular inspection of electrical panels, cables and earthing systems.
* Ensure proper earthing and electrical protection systems.
* Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance.
* Ensure electrical installations comply with applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain electrical safety inspection records.

F. Spare Parts & Inventory Management

* Maintain electrical spare parts inventory.
* Identify critical electrical spares for production machinery.
* Prepare purchase requests for electrical components.
* Coordinate with suppliers for procurement and replacement of spares.
* Monitor spare consumption and control maintenance costs.

G. Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules.
* Prepare daily electrical breakdown reports.
* Maintain machine electrical history records.
* Update electrical drawings and panel modification records.
* Prepare monthly electricity consumption reports.
* Submit maintenance performance reports to the Maintenance Manager.

title: Sr. Automation Test Engineer
description:
5G Test Automation Role (PCRF/PCF/SCP/NRF):

Experience: 5 - 10 years

Automation Scripting: Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites from scratch using Python, Tcl/iTcl, or Robot Framework to validate 5G cloud-native Network Functions.

Framework Management: Build and maintain automated test pipelines using Gherkin syntax, PCWEB, or similar test tools, ensuring strict execution of regression and stability pools.

5G Architecture Testing: Execute automated validation for Service-Based Architecture (SBA) flows across 5G Core functions including SCP, NRF, PCF, and 4G PCRF.

Signaling & Protocol Verification: Validate 5G control plane protocols (HTTP/2, REST APIs, JSON/YAML) and 4G Diameter interfaces (Gx, Gy, Rx, Sd, Sy) through automated signaling scripts.

Call Flow & Routing Automation: Automate the end-to-end testing of SCP routing rules, delegated discovery, Model-C/D communication, and NRF profile registration/heartbeats.

Resiliency & HA Validation: Develop automated chaos and failover test cases to evaluate pod failures, ungraceful terminations, and interface switchovers in a CUPS environment.

Performance & Capacity Benchmarking: Script automated load, capacity, and stress tests to monitor CPU trends, maximum signaling limits, and maximum simultaneous PDU sessions.

Cloud-Native Integration: Deploy and execute test automation frameworks natively inside containerized Kubernetes and OpenShift cluster environments.

Observability Tracking: Integrate automated scripts with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch to track real-time application metrics and KPI synchronization.

title: Sr. Telecommunication Engineer
description:
Location - Banglore

  
  

Oracle Communications – 5G Core Network Functions Test & Deployment Engineer

  
  

Focus: SCP, NRF, SEPP

  
  

Job Summary

  
  

We are looking for a skilled Oracle Communications 5G Core Network Functions Test & Deployment Engineer to support testing, deployment, upgrade, integration, and validation activities for Oracle 5G Core Network Functions, mainly SCP, NRF, and SEPP.

  
  

The candidate should have good understanding of 5G SA Core architecture, Service-Based Architecture, SCP configuration, NRF registration/discovery, SEPP roaming/interconnect, and 5G SBA communication models, especially Model-C and Model-D.

title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Alexa Connections is on a mission to become the world's most trusted communication agent, spanning across calls, text, email, and the ever-expanding surfaces where people connect. We're building intelligence that keeps customers connected effortlessly to their network and beyond, while putting their trust and privacy first. As an Applied Scientist, you'll help build the smartest communications agent for people, an agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, and that acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel effortless and genuinely helpful  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll research and build the intelligence that helps people stay connected to the ones who matter. A central part of this is modeling each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of their relationships and communication patterns, and using it to power an assistant that is context-aware and grows more helpful over time. You'll draw on large language models, agentic reasoning, and personalization to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect, and to act on their behalf across calls, text, and email. It's open-ended research applied to a real product, turning advances in personalization and memory into an agent that genuinely understands the people in a customer's life.  
  
About the team  
We're building up the Alexa Connections science team, so you'll join early and grow alongside it. You'll work closely with experienced scientists and engineers invested in your development, with plenty of mentorship, room to broaden your skills, and the chance to own meaningful problems as you grow. It's a supportive place to do impactful work early in your career, shaping how millions of customers connect every day.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Product Test Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

This hybrid Product Test Engineer role focuses on validating complex health care administration solutions built on Facets and TriZetto Elements for payer and provider clients. The engineer will design and execute robust functional and integration tests for enrollment benefit configuration and claims workflows ensuring high reliability and regulatory compliance. The role impacts health plan members and care providers through improved accuracy reduced processing defects and enhanced digital

**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test scenarios for Facets enrollment workflows that ensure accurate member intake processing and reduce downstream defects in payer and provider operations.
* Develop and maintain reusable test cases and data sets for Facets benefit configuration that validate complex plan designs and improve reliability of benefit administration for diverse health plan offerings.
* Execute functional integration and regression testing for Facets claims processing to confirm correct adjudication logic and to minimize claim payment errors that impact providers and members.
* Coordinate end to end test cycles across Facets and TriZetto Elements modules to verify seamless data flow between enrollment benefits and claims components within integrated product releases.
* Analyze production like defects and root causes in payer and provider use cases and translate findings into targeted regression coverage and improvements in test design for future releases.
* Collaborate closely with product managers business analysts and configuration teams to clarify requirements and ensure test conditions accurately reflect real world payer and provider scenarios.
* Create and refine test data that mirrors complex provider networks member benefit combinations and claim scenarios to strengthen test depth and increase confidence in product behavior under varied conditions.
* Document clear test results defect details and impact assessments that help development and configuration teams resolve issues quickly and maintain high quality standards for client delivery.
* Use domain knowledge of payer and provider processes to validate compliance with business rules contractual obligations and regulatory expectations within Facets and TriZetto Elements solutions.
* Support performance and volume oriented test activities by modeling realistic enrollment loads benefit updates and claim submission patterns that reflect large scale health plan operations.
* Engage with implementation and support teams in a hybrid work model to review client specific configurations and share test insights that reduce implementation risk and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test frameworks checklists and best practices for Facets and TriZetto Elements testing to improve efficiency and consistency across product releases.
* Mentor junior test engineers in understanding payer and provider workflows and in applying structured test design techniques that raise overall team capability and product quality.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in Facets enrollment testing with detailed understanding of member eligibility rules group structures and related configuration impacts on downstream processes.
* Apply advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration by designing tests that cover complex benefit hierarchies accumulators and cost sharing rules for varied health plan products.
* Utilize practical expertise with Facets claims modules to verify claim pricing accumulation and payment rules while ensuring alignment with payer reimbursement policies and provider contracts.
* Bring working experience in TriZetto Elements to validate integration points configuration consistency and data exchange between TriZetto tools and core Facets components.
* Exhibit solid domain understanding of payer operations such as enrollment premium handling benefits administration and claims adjudication to design realistic and business relevant test scenarios.
* Apply provider domain knowledge to test scenarios involving provider contracting reimbursement patterns and network participation attributes reflected in claims and benefit configuration.
* Use strong analytical and problem solving abilities to interpret complex defects reproduce issues reliably and recommend test coverage enhancements based on observed patterns in health care data.

title: Sr IT Security Specialist
description:
**Overview**

The Sr. IT Security Specialist serves as a senior technical authority and key operational lead within the IT Security Team. Scaled for an experienced security practitioner (9–15 years of experience), this role bridges tactical security operations, advanced incident handling, and cross-functional security guidance.  
  
While remaining hands-on and technical, the Sr. Specialist exercises broad independent judgment, takes ownership of enterprise risk mitigation, drives root-cause elimination, and guides junior and mid-level team members. The role works closely with Infrastructure, Network, OT, and Compliance teams to maintain resilient systems, optimize security controls, and strengthen the overall posture of the enterprise.

**Targeted Outcomes (12 Months)**

* **Escalation & Operational Leadership:** Act as the primary technical escalation point for junior and mid-level security staff, complex operational questions, and severe security events.
* **Advanced Incident Management:** Independently lead high-complexity security event investigations, forensic analysis, and end-to-end response coordination.
* **Root-Cause Elimination:** Drive deep-dive postmortems for recurring security issues and implement systemic long-term remediation actions.
* **Process & Control Refinement:** Lead initiatives to refine SIEM/EDR detection rules, security metrics, reporting frameworks, and incident response playbooks.
* **Autonomous Project Delivery:** Support major security engineering projects and infrastructure improvements with minimal supervision, strong decision-making, and high execution quality.

**Primary Focus**

* Advanced incident handling, forensic investigation, and escalation
* Mentorship, peer guidance, and technical leadership
* Root cause analysis, trend identification, and postmortem engineering
* Security monitoring, detection, and process optimization
* Cross-functional coordination across IT, Network, Cloud, and OT environments

**Key Responsibilities**

**Advanced Operations & Escalation**

* Provide expert guidance to junior and mid-level security resources, serving as the senior point of escalation within the IT Security Team.
* Perform advanced daily security telemetry analysis using modern SIEM, EDR, NDR, and threat intelligence tools, quickly isolating high-risk threats from background noise.
* Respond to, resolve, or escalate complex security incidents, including high-severity events escalated by the MDR provider.

**Incident Response & Forensic Analysis**

* Investigate enterprise security violations and lead thorough postmortem analyses to identify systemic vulnerabilities, threat trends, and remediation opportunities.
* Support updates and continuous testing for Incident Response (IR) and Disaster Recovery (DR) plans.
* Participate in a senior-tier on-call rotation for critical incident escalations.

**Vulnerability Management & Threat Mitigation**

* Research emerging cyber threats and zero-day vulnerabilities, translating threat intelligence into proactive defense measures.
* Review, prioritize, and execute remediation strategies for penetration test and vulnerability assessment findings.
* Recommend, schedule, or apply critical security fixes, patches, and defensive controls in response to active risks or breaches.

**Enterprise & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Infrastructure Team to secure and ensure the integrity of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Partner with the Network Team to maintain the security integrity of WAN, LAN, telephony systems, and Operational Technology (OT) networks.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders to align daily security operations with the enterprise-wide risk management framework.

**Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Produce executive-level monthly exception, metrics, and incident reporting to inform leadership on enterprise security posture.
* Support annual IT security audits, regulatory compliance inquiries, and customer security assessments.
* Monitor policy adherence across the enterprise and execute corrective action plans where non-conformities are identified.
* Manage incident and change request service levels (SLAs) according to IT service management guidelines.
* Develop, standardize, and maintain technical documentation for security platforms and operational procedures.

**Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 7 to 13 years of hands-on experience in IT security, security operations (SOC), threat management, or security engineering.
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex security investigations, root-cause analyses, and cross-functional remediation projects.
* Proven experience working across diverse environments, including on-premises infrastructure, cloud workloads, and network/OT environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Advanced industry certifications preferred (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, CEH, or CCSP).

**Key Skills & Capabilities**

* Technical Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of security operations, modern SIEM/EDR tools, threat hunting methodologies, network security protocols, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK).
* Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to collaborate with and influence infrastructure, network, and application teams without formal authority.
* Problem Solving & Agility: Strong analytical skills with the ability to remain calm, focused, and decisive in time-sensitive incident scenarios.
* Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a natural propensity for mentoring peer engineers and explaining complex risks to non-technical stakeholders.

**Work Environment**

* **On-Call Availability:** Requires participation in an on-call rotation to respond to high-severity security incidents.
* **Travel:** Occasional travel (5–10%) may be required for conferences, business audits, or site assessments.
* **Autonomy:** Demands high independent judgment while operating effectively within a collaborative enterprise team.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation**

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.  
  
**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We're bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Lead Flow Assurance Engineer** to join our Perth team on a part-time, fixed-term contract basis.

This role is ideally suited to a highly experienced flow assurance specialist seeking a flexible working arrangement while continuing to provide technical leadership on complex subsea and energy infrastructure projects. The position will support a portfolio of concept, FEED and detailed design activities, working closely with clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

**About the role**

As a senior technical leader within our specialist Flow Assurance team, you will provide technical direction, mentorship and client-facing leadership across a range of offshore, subsea and energy transition projects. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality flow assurance solutions while supporting project teams and maintaining strong client relationships.

Your work will include:

* Multiphase flow simulations including steady-state and dynamic analysis.

* Oil and gas product pipeline hydraulic studies.

* Input to safety, reliability and risk assessment studies.

Typical responsibilities will include:

* Leading and mentoring teams of Flow Assurance Engineers, including the technical development of junior engineers.
* Acting as a key client interface across conceptual engineering, FEED and detailed design projects.

* Providing technical assurance and governance across flow assurance studies and project deliverables.
* Development and compilation of CTR hour estimates for scopes of work.
* Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams across subsea, pipelines, process and facilities disciplines.
* Preparing and reviewing technical reports, specifications, engineering deliverables and client presentations.
* Supporting business development activities, proposal preparation and client relationship management.
* Providing specialist technical advice to clients and project teams.

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years' experience in flow assurance engineering, with a preference for 18+ years of subsea flow assurance experience.
* Advanced knowledge and practical application of OLGA and PipeSim software.
* Demonstrated expertise in both steady-state and transient flow assurance analysis.
* Proven experience leading, mentoring and developing teams of Flow Assurance Engineers.
* Strong client engagement, stakeholder management and technical leadership capabilities.
* Experience delivering conceptual engineering, FEED and detailed design projects.
* Experience delivering Operations Production Support to operators within oil and gas facilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why Worley**

* Flexible part-time working arrangement.
* Opportunity to contribute to technically challenging projects while maintaining work-life balance.
* Lead and mentor a team of highly capable engineers and specialists.
* Support major offshore developments and energy transition initiatives.
* Access Worley's global expertise, networks and project portfolio.
* Apply your extensive experience in a role focused on technical leadership and client engagement.

**Benefits**

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
* Competitive remuneration and employee benefits.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Global project exposure and the opportunity to work with industry-leading experts.
* Inclusive, diverse and collaborative workplace culture.
* Wellbeing support programs and employee assistance services.
* The opportunity to contribute to projects supporting the energy transition.

**About us**

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. Right now, we're bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. With approximately 50,000 people in 45 countries, we combine deep technical expertise with digital innovation to solve the world's most critical challenges.

**Moving forward together**

We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves and are supported to thrive. We welcome applications from suitably qualified people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

We are committed to flexible working arrangements and recognise the value they bring to our people, customers and communities. Our focus is on creating an environment where everyone can achieve their professional and personal goals while contributing to meaningful work.

* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified

* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.
* Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models.
* Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability.
* Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

We are looking for a highly motivated Telematics Systems Validation Engineer with  
expertise in Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Testing, Embedded Software Validation,  
Python Test Automation, and Electronic Control Systems.  
The role involves validating telematics software using HIL simulation environments that  
emulate machine and engine behavior under real-world operating and fault conditions. The  
ideal candidate should be able to understand system requirements, design complex  
validation scenarios, execute automated and manual tests, analyze logs, identify software  
defects, and collaborate with global engineering teams.  
Experience with dSPACE HIL systems, embedded controls, CAN/J1939 communication,  
and telematics technologies is highly preferred.

**HIL Testing & System Validation**  

* Analyze telematics software and system requirements.
* Develop traceable test scenarios and validation strategies.
* Execute:

o Functional Testing  
o Integration Testing  
o System Testing  
o Fault Injection Testing  
o Negative Testing  
o Regression Testing  

* Validate telematics functionality under simulated real-world conditions.

**Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)**  

* Configure, operate, and maintain HIL environments.
* Troubleshoot HIL benches and simulation setups.
* Support hardware interfaces, wiring harnesses, and plant models.

**Python Test Automation**  

* Develop and maintain automated validation frameworks using Python.
* Build reusable automated test libraries.

* Automate execution and reporting processes.

Defect Investigation & Root Cause Analysis  

* Analyze logs, network traces, and system behavior.
* Identify software defects and validation gaps.
* Differentiate product issues from test environment issues.

* Verify fixes through retesting and regression validation.

title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role
  
We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to focus primarily on capacity and demand planning across data centers and public cloud. You will combine practical infrastructure experience with analytical thinking and strong internal customer relationships to translate future demand into clear capacity models, options, and timely decisions. This is a hands-on planning role grounded in how production infrastructure actually performs.
  
  
You will proactively engage engineering, application, product, and business teams, and help drive capacity and cost discussions with our existing FinOps engineers. Leadership owns approved forecasts, procurement and investment recommendations and decisions, and team backlog priorities. You provide the evidence, facilitate the planning cadence, and surface issues early.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Build trusted relationships and proactive demand intake with internal customers, connecting delivery plans, workload changes, and business growth to infrastructure needs.
* Develop headroom, runway, growth, and scenario models for data center and public cloud capacity, documenting assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, and changes in demand.
* Validate sizing against production evidence, peak demand, failover conditions, and performance requirements, rather than treating average utilization as sufficient.
* Account for hardware lifecycle and procurement lead times, cloud quotas, regional availability, and provisioning constraints when developing timing and capacity options.
* Run a leadership-sponsored planning cadence, maintain clear analytical inputs, and escalate approved threshold crossings for review. Thresholds trigger discussion, not automatic purchases.
* Help drive FinOps discussions with existing FinOps engineers: facilitate consumption, demand, capacity, and cost conversations; support consumption and spend forecast scenarios; and follow up with agreed action owners without controlling their backlogs.
* Partner on rightsizing, reclamation, total cost of ownership, workload placement, and commitment analysis. Validate potential savings against resilience and performance needs; FinOps specialists retain ownership of their practice and program.

Requirements
  
  

* Five or more years of practical infrastructure engineering or operations experience, with the technical depth and independent judgment expected of a senior engineer. We welcome candidates whose experience has been built in infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams in a global environment. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with the US Eastern business day is required.

Technical Requirements
  
  

* Practical understanding of virtualization, compute, operating systems, storage capacity and performance (IOPS, latency, and throughput), networks, and resilience. Experience with platforms such as VMware or Nutanix and Windows or Linux is relevant; specific vendors are not required.
* Ability to interpret observability and time-series data, assess public cloud capacity constraints, and build demand forecasts using Excel, SQL, Python, or equivalent data analysis tools.

**Working Experience with:**  

* Sizing production workloads and validating capacity assumptions against real telemetry, workload behavior, service objectives, and operational constraints.
* Translating cross-team demand into planning inputs and collaborating with globally distributed teams to resolve gaps, dependencies, and competing assumptions.

Must-Have Capabilities
  
  

* Personal, practical infrastructure depth: explain how resources, bottlenecks, failure modes, and workload behavior affect usable capacity.
* Translate customer demand into defensible forecasts and scenarios, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and risks.
* Facilitate constructive stakeholder conversations, challenge weak assumptions respectfully, and apply sound technical judgment to capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Collaborate effectively with FinOps engineers and service owners, making cost-aware options understandable without compromising performance or resilience.

What This Role Is NOT
  
  

* A general infrastructure delivery or ticket-queue role measured primarily by throughput, or a position intended to backfill on-call coverage. Operational experience informs the work; capacity and demand planning remain the primary focus.
* Ownership of approved forecasts, spend approval, procurement or investment recommendations and decisions, architecture, team backlog priorities, or the FinOps program. You develop analytical inputs and options in partnership with the accountable owners.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Prior specialist FinOps experience or certification, and experience supporting cloud cost optimization or commitment analysis. These are preferred, not required.
* Automation that improves telemetry collection, model inputs, or repeatable analysis. Terraform, Ansible, Git, CI/CD, and Kubernetes experience can be useful, but none is mandatory.

How You’ll Be Successful / Bottom Line
  
You combine hands-on infrastructure knowledge with analytical judgment and strong working relationships to help our teams plan ahead. You work with internal customers and engineers to translate business demand into clear capacity requirements across data center and cloud environments, validate assumptions, and surface constraints early.
  
  
You help drive FinOps discussions in partnership with our FinOps engineers, connecting capacity needs, resource utilization, and cost tradeoffs without compromising performance or resilience. Your success is measured by the quality of your planning inputs, stakeholder engagement, and timely analysis that supports leadership’s forecast, investment, and procurement decisions. Capacity planning is your primary focus; automation supports that work rather than defining the role.

title: L2 Managed Service Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities

· Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.

· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.

· Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.

· Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.

· Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.

· Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.

· Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.

· Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.

· Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).

· Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.

· Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).

· Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.

· Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

Required Skills and Experience

Observability Platform Skills

· 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.

· Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting.

· Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).

· APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.

· Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.

· RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces.

· Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics.

· Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.

· Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.

· Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.

· Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.

· Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.

Application and Architecture Understanding

· Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.

· Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns.

· Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.

· Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.

Good to Have

· Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).

· Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.

· Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.

· Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).

Soft Skills

· Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.

· Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.

· Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.

· Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents.

· Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Work Details

· **Level:** L2 (Mid-level, Managed Services)

· **Shift:** 24x7 rotational shifts, with on-call/escalation coverage as needed

· **Reporting To:** L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Purchase Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: Purchase Manager – Civil Engineering / Construction

**Department:** Purchase / Procurement  
**Reports To:** Managing Director / General Manager / Project Head  
**Industry:** Civil Engineering & Construction  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Purchase Manager is responsible for planning, sourcing, negotiating, purchasing, and ensuring timely delivery of construction materials, equipment, tools, and services required for various project sites. The role ensures that all purchases meet required technical specifications, quality standards, project schedules, and approved budgets while maintaining reliable relationships with suppliers and vendors.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Procurement Planning**

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Planning Engineers, and Stores personnel to understand material requirements.
* Review Purchase Requisitions (PR/MR) received from project sites.
* Prepare procurement schedules based on project requirements and construction programmes.
* Identify long-lead materials and initiate procurement well in advance to avoid project delays.
* Monitor pending purchase requirements and ensure timely closure.

**2. Vendor Identification & Development**

* Identify suitable manufacturers, authorised dealers, suppliers, and service providers.
* Obtain quotations from multiple vendors and prepare comparative statements.
* Evaluate vendors based on price, quality, delivery capability, payment terms, past performance, and reliability.
* Develop alternate suppliers for critical construction materials to reduce procurement risk.
* Maintain and periodically update the Approved Vendor List.

**3. Negotiation & Purchase Orders**

* Negotiate prices, discounts, credit periods, transportation charges, delivery schedules, warranties, and other commercial terms.
* Ensure purchases are made at competitive market rates without compromising quality.
* Prepare and issue Purchase Orders (POs) with clear specifications, quantities, rates, taxes, delivery locations, and commercial terms.
* Obtain necessary management approval before finalising major purchases.
* Maintain proper records of quotations, comparative statements, approvals, and Purchase Orders.

**4. Construction Material Procurement**

Handle procurement of materials including, but not limited to:

* Cement and construction chemicals
* TMT/Reinforcement steel and structural steel
* M-Sand, P-Sand and aggregates
* Ready-Mix Concrete (RMC)
* Bricks, blocks and AAC blocks
* Tiles, granite, marble and other flooring materials
* Doors, windows, glass and hardware
* Paints and finishing materials
* False ceiling and interior materials
* Scaffolding and shuttering/formwork materials
* Safety materials and PPE
* Tools, machinery, equipment and consumables
* Other civil, structural and MEP materials required for projects

**5. Technical & Quality Coordination**

* Ensure Purchase Orders comply with approved BOQ, drawings, specifications, makes/brands, and project requirements.
* Coordinate with technical teams before placing orders for specialised materials.
* Arrange material samples, technical data sheets, catalogues, and manufacturer approvals when required.
* Coordinate with QA/QC and site teams regarding material quality issues.
* Ensure rejected or defective materials are replaced by suppliers promptly.

**6. Delivery & Logistics**

* Follow up with vendors for timely dispatch and delivery of materials to project sites.
* Coordinate transportation and logistics where required.
* Monitor critical deliveries to ensure construction activities are not affected by material shortages.
* Coordinate with Site Stores for receipt, inspection, and documentation of delivered materials.
* Resolve shortages, damages, incorrect supplies, and delayed deliveries.

**7. Cost Control & Market Analysis**

* Monitor market prices of major construction materials such as cement, steel, RMC, aggregates, and finishing materials.
* Maintain historical purchase-price data for comparison and negotiation.
* Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing, rate contracts, and annual agreements.
* Support management in reducing procurement costs without compromising required quality.
* Compare budgeted material costs against actual procurement costs and highlight significant variations.

**8. Vendor & Payment Coordination**

* Verify supplier invoices against Purchase Orders, delivery challans, and Goods Receipt Notes (GRN).
* Coordinate with Accounts Department for invoice processing and vendor payments.
* Resolve discrepancies relating to rates, quantities, taxes, freight, and other commercial terms.
* Monitor supplier credit limits and payment terms.
* Maintain professional relationships with key suppliers.

**9. Inventory & Stores Coordination**

* Coordinate with Stores Department regarding stock availability before making new purchases.
* Avoid excess procurement and unnecessary inventory.
* Monitor consumption of high-value and frequently used construction materials.
* Assist in identifying slow-moving, surplus, and obsolete materials.
* Facilitate inter-site transfer of available materials wherever economically beneficial.

**10. MIS & Documentation**

* Maintain Purchase Order registers and procurement trackers.
* Prepare weekly/monthly procurement status reports.
* Maintain vendor-wise and material-wise purchase records.
* Prepare reports on pending Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders, deliveries, and payments.
* Maintain proper documentation for internal audits and management review.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be measured based on:

* On-time availability of materials at project sites
* Procurement cost savings
* Reduction in emergency/local purchases
* Purchase Order turnaround time
* Vendor delivery performance
* Material quality and rejection rate
* Number of reliable/approved vendors developed
* Compliance with approved procurement procedures
* Reduction in material shortages and project delays due to procurement
* Accuracy of procurement documentation and MIS reports

Educational Qualification

* **Preferred:** Any Degree/B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering
* Candidates with qualifications in Supply Chain Management, Materials Management, or Procurement with strong construction-industry experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **Preferred:** 7–15 years of procurement/purchase experience in civil engineering or construction companies.
* Experience in industrial buildings, factories, warehouses, commercial buildings, institutional projects, and residential construction will be an advantage.
* Should have strong knowledge of local construction-material suppliers and market rates.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of civil construction materials and specifications
* Vendor sourcing and development
* Commercial negotiation and cost analysis
* Purchase Order preparation and administration
* Construction-material price analysis
* Supplier performance management
* Inventory and stores coordination
* Basic understanding of GST and purchase-related taxation
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and procurement/MIS reporting
* ERP/accounting software knowledge will be an advantage
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to handle multiple project requirements simultaneously
* Ability to work under project deadlines and procurement pressure

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing procurement for multiple construction sites and possess a strong supplier network. The candidate should be commercially competent, technically aware of construction materials, systematic in documentation, and capable of ensuring the **right material, right quality, right quantity, right price, and right delivery time** for every project.

Authority & Accountability

The Purchase Manager shall be responsible for ensuring that procurement activities are carried out strictly in accordance with company policies, approved specifications, budgets, and management authorisations. Any major deviation in specification, price, quantity, supplier, or commercial terms shall be brought to management's attention and approved before purchase.

Job Description

Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst (Red Hat Linux, GRID Infrastructure L3 Support Engineer)

The Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst is an intermediate-level technical role responsible for providing Level 3 support, engineering, remediation, and operational excellence across the Unified Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) estate consisting of more than 100,000+ servers. The role requires deep expertise in Linux administration, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, security hardening, automation, and configuration management. The overall objective is to leverage advanced infrastructure technology knowledge, operational policies, and engineering best practices to maintain platform stability, security, compliance, and service availability.

Responsibilities

* Provide Level 3 technical support for complex Red Hat Enterprise Linux, GRID infrastructure server incidents, escalations, and critical production outages across a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of high-impact operating system, kernel, performance, storage, networking, and server infrastructure issues to restore services within agreed SLAs.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following service restoration and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Design and implement server security hardening standards in accordance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Manage vulnerability remediation activities, security patching, operating system lifecycle management, and compliance controls across the Red Hat server estate.
* Administer and troubleshoot infrastructure agents including monitoring, security, backup, automation, compliance, and endpoint management agents deployed across Linux servers.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize Ansible playbooks for server provisioning, configuration management, patching, security remediation, and operational automation.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and develop engineering solutions to improve platform stability, efficiency, and operational resilience.
* Review infrastructure requirements, define operating system standards, and update operational processes, procedures, and technical documentation as required.
* Conduct proactive system health reviews, capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational risk assessments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic guidance to team members and operational support teams.
* Collaborate with security, application, middleware, storage, network, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges.
* Support operating system upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity initiatives.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and security frameworks.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Red Hat Enterprise Linux platforms and associated technologies when engaging with senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and project groups.
* Operate independently with minimal supervision while demonstrating strong ownership, sound judgment, and decision-making capabilities.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations; adhering to policy; applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices; and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, GRID infrastructure and troubleshooting.
* Advanced knowledge of Linux kernel, system performance tuning, networking, storage, LVM, multipathing, clustering, and filesystem management.
* Experience in enterprise server security hardening, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Ansible automation and playbook development.
* Experience with Chef configuration management and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of monitoring, backup, security, and compliance agents deployed in enterprise Linux environments.
* Experience supporting mission-critical production environments at large scale.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.
* Familiarity with virtualization, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices is advantageous.

title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.

Responsibilities:

1. Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.

2. Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.

3. Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.

4. Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.

5. Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.

6. Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.

7. Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.

8. Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

Desired Qualifications:

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

2. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.

3. Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.

4. Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.

5. Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.

6. Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.

7. Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.

8. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.

2. Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.

3. Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.

4. Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.

5. Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.

6. Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.

Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

October 13, 2026 - October 26, 2026

title: Lead Engineer - L3 Observability
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies.
* Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles.
* Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented.
* Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads.
* Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends.
* Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management.
* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices).
* Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including:
* Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups.
* APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments.
* Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs.

* Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments.

* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.
* Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units.

**Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic)**

* Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers.
* Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging.
* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents.
* Strong documentation and process-governance discipline.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* **Level:** L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations
