description:
**Senior Executive – Recruitment \& Project Staffing Coordination**

**Company:** Greenwarrior

**Department:** Human Resources \& Project Operations

**Location:** Thiruvallur

**Experience:** Preferably 4–7 years in recruitment and manpower mobilisation

**Employment:** Full\-time

**Role Purpose**

We are seeking a multilingual recruitment and staffing professional with experience in recruiting blue\-collar manpower for municipal solid waste management and mining operations, along with the ability to recruit white\-collar professionals for the waste management industry.

Our recruitment requirements depend on ongoing projects, bidding opportunities and new contract awards. This role combines recruitment with manpower planning, field staffing support, employee coordination and recruitment readiness during periods of limited hiring.

**Blue Collar Recruitment and Mobilisation**

· Recruit sanitation workers, waste collection workers, segregation workers, helpers, drivers, equipment operators, mechanics, electricians, welders and other project manpower.

· Source workers for mining operations, including relevant equipment operators, maintenance personnel, drivers and site support staff.

· Manage sourcing, screening, interview coordination, document collection, joining and deployment.

· Coordinate with project teams to verify driving licences, trade skills, operating experience and other role\-specific requirements.

· Arrange recruitment drives and coordinate worker travel, reporting locations and accommodation requirements with authorised project teams.

· Maintain backup candidates for urgent replacements, absenteeism and project mobilisation.

**Recruitment and Staffing Responsibilities Interstate Recruitment Networks**

· Possess and maintain an active network of recruitment agents, manpower suppliers, local coordinators, employee referrals, ITIs and skill\-training institutions across different states.

· Develop sourcing channels for both local and interstate manpower.

· Assess recruitment partners based on candidate quality, joining reliability, retention and agreed recruitment costs.

· Maintain a source database recording locations served, categories available, contact details and recruitment performance.

· Communicate wages, duties, shifts, location and facilities accurately to candidates; escalate misleading promises or unauthorised recruitment charges.

**White Collar Recruitment**

· Recruit Project Managers, engineers, plant and maintenance personnel, supervisors, safety officers, HR executives, accounts staff, procurement personnel, MIS executives and tendering staff for waste management projects.

· Prepare job descriptions with department heads, screen candidates and coordinate technical interviews.

· Handle compensation discussions within approved budgets and follow through on offers, notice periods and joining.

· Build candidate pipelines for anticipated project requirements.

**Field Staffing and Project HR Coordination**

· Act as the staffing coordination contact between the corporate office, Field Managers and Project Company HR Managers.

· Obtain manpower requirements and track sanctioned strength, deployment, vacancies, absenteeism and replacement needs.

· Provide regular staffing updates to Field Managers and management.

· Liaise with Project HR Managers on joining formalities, attendance discrepancies, transfers, accommodation issues, employee concerns and exits.

· Coordinate timely replacements and support retention of newly recruited workers.

· Escalate staffing shortages and unresolved employee issues that may affect project operations.

**Project and Bid Stage Support**

· Support management with manpower availability, indicative recruitment lead times and sourcing inputs for proposed projects and bids.

· Prepare recruitment and mobilisation plans based on approved project staffing requirements.

· Maintain a ready pool of suitable candidates and recruitment partners for new project awards.

· Communicate clearly when an opportunity is conditional on a contract award; issue commitments only after internal approval.

Candidate Requirements and PerformanceResponsibilities During Low Hiring Periods

· Update candidate databases, recruitment partner records and employee skill inventories.

· Follow up with deployed employees and project teams on retention, staffing gaps and pending onboarding documents.

· Coordinate redeployment opportunities between projects.

· Support HR documentation, induction scheduling, training coordination and staffing\-related administrative work.

· Prepare recruitment and manpower reports, and maintain readiness for upcoming projects.

**Language Requirements**

· **Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English and Kannada**: Working conversational proficiency required to communicate with candidates, recruitment agents and project teams.

· Ability to explain job conditions, wages, shifts, deployment locations and joining requirements clearly in the above languages.

· Ability to prepare professional emails, recruitment trackers and reports in English. Reading and writing ability in regional languages will be an added advantage.

**Education and Experience**

· Graduate in any discipline; MBA / MSW / postgraduate qualification in Human Resources preferred.

· Preferably 4–7 years of relevant experience in recruitment, manpower mobilisation or project staffing.

· Hands\-on blue\-collar recruitment experience in municipal waste management and mining operations.

· Demonstrated ability to recruit white\-collar personnel for waste management or related project operations.

· Proven interstate sourcing network and experience coordinating with recruitment agents and project HR teams. Candidates with strong practical experience and established sourcing networks may be considered with equivalent qualifications.

**Essential Skills**

Multilingual communication and negotiation; recruitment planning, screening and joining follow\-up; relationship management with agents and project teams; ability to handle urgent requirements and changing priorities; proficiency in Excel, email, recruitment portals, candidate databases and MIS reporting; willingness to travel; and ability to work independently across recruitment, staffing coordination and related HR support duties.

**Performance Measures**

Timely fulfilment of approved manpower requirements; candidate joining rates and retention at 30, 60 and 90 days; replacement speed and quality; recruitment cost within approved budgets; sourcing partner reliability; accurate staffing reports and onboarding records; responsiveness to field and HR teams; and candidate pipeline readiness.

Performance will be assessed against actual project requirements and staffing support delivered, recognising that recruitment volumes vary with project awards.

**Compensation:** Based on relevant experience, language proficiency, industry exposure and demonstrated recruitment network.

title: Technical Manager - SOC
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Cybersecurity Engineer to lead the design, engineering, deployment, optimization, and ongoing improvement of enterprise security controls and platforms. The role requires strong hands\-on expertise across EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, identity security, vulnerability management, and security automation. The successful candidate will drive technical implementation initiatives, strengthen detection and response capabilities, support SOC operations, and ensure security controls align with organizational strategy, risk posture, and compliance requirements.

  

  

Key Responsibilities :


* Lead the design, engineering, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise security tools and platforms, including EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, and Microsoft 365 security solutions.
* Architect and implement scalable security controls to protect endpoints, networks, cloud workloads, identity systems, and business\-critical infrastructure.
* Manage and optimize integrations across security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, SOAR, MDM, IAM, and related monitoring tools.
* Drive incident detection and response engineering through alert tuning, detection use case development, correlation logic, and automation playbooks.
* Oversee deployment and enforcement of endpoint security controls, including DLP, USB/device control, device compliance policies, and endpoint hardening standards.
* Collaborate with SOC, Infrastructure, IAM, Cloud, and application teams to ensure security controls are implemented, monitored, and operationalized effectively.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for security events, tool failures, policy issues, log ingestion gaps, and control effectiveness concerns.
* Establish and maintain SIEM use cases, correlation rules, dashboards, reports, and operational metrics to improve monitoring and executive visibility.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, validate scan results, support remediation planning, and track risk reduction activities through closure.
* Participate in change management processes to assess security impact, define control requirements, and ensure security tooling remains aligned with approved changes.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell, Python, SOAR workflows, and other scripting methods to reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
* Develop and maintain security baselines, hardening standards, deployment playbooks, operational guides, and technical documentation.
* Monitor emerging threats, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to adapt detections and controls based on current attack trends.
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to junior engineers, SOC analysts, and cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Technical Responsibilities


* Engineer, deploy, and administer EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including policy tuning, threat detection, response actions, and control validation.
* Implement and manage SIEM platforms such as CrowdStrike NG SIEM or Splunk, including log onboarding, parsing, normalization, dashboarding, and advanced correlation logic.
* Design, implement, and support IDS/IPS and network security monitoring solutions to improve threat visibility, prevention, and investigation capability.
* Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 Security capabilities, including Microsoft Defender Suite, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Secure Score improvements, and identity protection controls.
* Manage MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent solutions for device compliance, device posture, policy enforcement, and access control.
* Implement of identity security controls, including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access controls, least privilege, and Zero Trust principles.
* Build and maintain SOC automation and SOAR workflows for incident triage, evidence collection, containment actions, enrichment, notification, and reporting.
* Integrate and manage threat intelligence feeds across security tools to support proactive detection, enrichment, and threat hunting.
* Perform log source integration across servers, endpoints, network devices, cloud platforms, firewalls, identity systems, and business\-critical applications.
* Support compliance and audit activities, including HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS\-aligned evidence gathering, configuration review, reporting, and technical control validation.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience in security engineering, control implementation, and enterprise security tool deployment.
* Proven expertise in incident detection, incident response, alert tuning, threat hunting, and SOC enablement.
* Experience with firewalls, endpoint protection, cloud security controls, identity controls, and Microsoft security ecosystems.
* Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex multi\-layer security issues across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and application environments.
* Strong understanding of modern attack techniques, adversary behaviors, MITRE ATT\&CK framework, and detection engineering principles.
* Experience working in fast\-paced SOC, security engineering, or enterprise security operations environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, technical leadership, prioritization, and project execution skills.
  

  

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in IT Security, including at least 5\+ years in security engineering, implementation, or platform administration roles.
* Hands\-on experience with EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, and cloud security controls.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and benchmarks, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and CIS Benchmarks.
